title: Beach Bliss - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
BEACH BLISS Condo Highlights:

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 🏖️ Low-Rise Complex — Only 36 Units with a PRIVATE Beach for Owners & Guests 🚲 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes Included (Optional Child Carrier Rental Across the Street) 🛠️ Completely Remodeled Interior (March 2024) + Multi-Million Dollar Exterior Renovation (2023–2024) 📍 Centrally Located in Seagrove — Walk to Seaside, Restaurants & Shopping 🌅 South of 30A, Directly on the Gulf — Just Steps Until You’re on the Sand! 🏖️ Beach Chairs, Umbrellas & Cooler Provided for Guest Use 🏡 Ground-Floor Unit with Two Patios Overlooking the Large Community Pool 🛌 Sleeps Up to 6 — Triple Bunk Bed + Queen Sleeper Sofa (Upgraded Memory Foam Mattress) ☕ Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker 🌙 Blackout Curtains Throughout the Condo 👶 Pack ’n Play (Fits Perfectly in Master Closet — Bring Your Own Sheets) 🏊 Access to Resort-Style Community Pool 🚴 1.3 Miles to Seaside — Easy & Scenic Ride on Included Bikes 🧺 Washer/Dryer In Unit ⚡ Fast Wi-Fi @ 400 Mbps 📺 Smart TVs to Stream All Your Favorite Shows

Beach Bliss is a cute, very comfortable 1 bedroom poolside condo that sleeps 6 people. The kitchen has upgraded cabinets, with quartz counter tops. This condo is just perfect for weekend getaway or a wonderful week at the beach, with beach access just a few short steps away.

WHAT's NEARBY

This property is part of the Emerald Hill Condos, a Gulf-front complex with a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. You will be across the street from several shops, eateries, and recreational outfitters that rent bikes and kayaks. Seaside is 1.3 miles away on the 30A bike path.

THINGS TO KNOW:

Parking notes: 1 spot per unit. No assigned spot, can park in any spot that is not in front of a garage.

The rental is located on the ground floor.

Sorry, no pets per HOA.

Golf carts are not allowed on property. However, there is golf cart rental conveniently located across the street at Butterfly Bike and Kayak. They allow you to park/charge there when you rent from them.

Property Type: Condo in a condo on the 1st floor
Sleeping Arrangements: Common Spaces - 1 Bunk Bed, 1 Sleeper Sofa
